faq.domanda: What are the advantages of window decoration compared to other forms of advertising?
faq.risposta: Window decoration immediately grabs the attention of passers-by and regular customers, offering an effective, low-cost form of visual advertising. It is ideal for strengthening your brand, promoting special offers or simply improving the look of your shop.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to decorate a shop window in Ticino?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the window, the type of design and the materials used. We offer free, tailored quotes in 24/48h to make sure you receive a service built around your needs.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to install decoration on a shop window?
faq.risposta: Installation generally takes four to five hours, though the time can vary depending on the complexity of the design and the size of the window.

faq.domanda: Is it possible to decorate only part of the window, such as the logo or a specific piece of text?
faq.risposta: Yes, you can decorate specific parts of the window, such as logos or slogans, for a targeted impact without having to cover the entire surface.

faq.domanda: What types of materials are used for window decoration?
faq.risposta: We use high-quality materials that are resistant to UV rays and the elements, ensuring the decoration keeps its appearance over time without fading or deteriorating.

faq.domanda: Is window decoration resistant to weather conditions?
faq.risposta: Yes, the materials we use are designed to withstand all weather conditions, ensuring durability and a flawless appearance even in heavy rain or strong sun.

faq.domanda: Does the window need to be cleaned before applying the decoration?
faq.risposta: Yes, it is essential for the window to be clean and free of dust or residue to ensure the decoration adheres perfectly.
